user.title: Add appliance
user.description: Monitor an appliance through the power sensor of its smart plug.

data_description.power_sensor: Power sensor of the smart plug (W or kW).

abort.already_configured: This power sensor is already monitored.

init.title: Detection settings
init.description: Defaults come from the device type. The end delay is a minimum: WashRData raises it when your programs have longer quiet spells.

data_description.start_power_w: At or above this power the appliance counts as active.
data_description.stop_power_w: Below this power the appliance counts as quiet. Must not be above the start power.
data_description.end_delay_min: Quiet time after which a cycle counts as finished.
data_description.anti_crease: Short drum turns after the end are anti-crease, not a new cycle.

error.stop_above_start: Stop power must not be above start power.

label_cycle.name: Label cycle
label_cycle.description: Assigns a program to a cycle. Unknown programs are created. Labelled cycles are used to recognise the program in future runs.

program.name: Program
program.description: Program name. Leave empty to remove the label.

cycle.name: Cycle
cycle.description: "current", "last" or a cycle id from the diagnostics. Default: the running cycle, otherwise the last one.

create_program.name: Create program
create_program.description: Adds a program to the program select.

rename_program.name: Rename program
rename_program.description: Renames a program, including its labelled cycles.

delete_program.name: Delete program
delete_program.description: Deletes a program. Its cycles are kept, unlabelled.

unknown_device.message: {device_id} is not a loaded WashRData device.
